真空光速始终相同: Light speed in vacuum stays the same
每次探测只留下一个点。许多同样准备的光子抵达后，落点积成明暗条纹。: Each detection leaves one dot. Many photons prepared in the same way build up bright and dark stripes.
两条缝都开着，条纹却没了: Both slits open. No interference stripes.
光变蓝，波峰变密，频率升高。每个光子的能量随之增加：E = hf。: As light turns blue, its crests move closer together and its frequency rises. Each photon carries more energy: E = hf.
红蓝两束光同时发出，走过同样的真空距离。能量不同，传播速度相同。: Red and blue pulses leave together and cross the same distance in vacuum. Their photon energies differ; their speed is the same.
光完整往返一次，钟走一拍。地面参考系中，飞船钟里的光走更长的斜线；光速相同，滴答: A full light round trip makes one tick. In the ground frame, light in the ship clock takes a longer diagonal path. At the same light speed, each tick takes longer.
光子是电磁场的量子，单次探测留下光点，落点分布由概率幅决定。: A photon is a quantum of the electromagnetic field. Each detection leaves one dot; probability amplitudes determine the pattern.
轻点画面让红蓝脉冲同时出发，比较它们走过相同距离的时刻。: Tap the scene to send red and blue pulses together. Compare their arrival over equal distances.
左右拖动光带，改变颜色；波长越短，每个光子的能量越高。: Drag the light band left or right to change its color. Shorter wavelengths mean more energy per photon.
有质量的钟无法加速到光速，光子也没有静止参考系。: A clock with mass cannot reach light speed. A photon has no rest frame.
以地面为参考，飞船钟在移动；光速相同，更长的光程需要更多时间。: In the ground frame, the ship clock moves. Light still travels at c, so the longer path takes more time.
以飞船为参考，地面钟在移动；每个人自己的钟都照常走。: In the ship frame, the ground clock moves. Everyone’s own clock runs normally.
